Privacy and website access

Updated 1 October 2026

Contacting Clive

Calling or texting from this website opens your device’s phone or messaging service. Information you choose to send, including contact details, truck details, location and photos, is sent to Clive through that service. Share only what is needed for your enquiry.

For questions about information you have provided, contact Clive on 0474 372 852.

Website technology

This website does not provide an online enquiry form, customer account or payment checkout. We have not added advertising pixels or visitor analytics to the website. Fonts and component files are served with the site.

The suburb and postcode lookup runs in your browser using a downloaded Victorian locality dataset. Search text is not sent to a lookup provider or saved by this website.

Website hosting and telecommunications providers can process technical information needed to provide their services. Their own privacy notices also apply. External links open other websites with their own practices.

Accessing the content

The component viewer is optional. Service information and contact details are also available as text. Use Pause to stop camera motion, Next angle to change view, or choose another component. Your device’s reduced motion preference stops automatic camera movement.

You can use a keyboard to reach links, buttons, the component selector and the location search. If something on this website is difficult to use, call or text Clive on 0474 372 852.

About this notice

This notice describes the website and its contact links. For information about how your enquiry or job records are handled beyond the website, contact Clive directly.
